gizmo.title: Crossword
gizmo.description: Crossword yakagadzirwa kubva murondedzero yemazwi nepfungwa. Gridi inogadzirirwa iwe; vadzidzi vanonyora mazwi vozviongorora.

configure.title: Musoro
configure.description: Musoro kana mubvunzo unoratidzwa pamusoro pecrossword.

configure.title: Mazwi
configure.description: Izwi rimwe nerimwe nepfungwa yaro. Gridi inogadzirwa kubva murondedzero iyi: izwi rakareba zvikuru rinoiswa kutanga uye mamwe anoriyambuka pamavara akagovaniswa.

advanced.title: Kuedza
advanced.description: Kangani mudzidzi anogona kutarisa. 0 zvinoreva kusingaperi.

advanced.title: Ruvara rwekusimbisa
advanced.description: Ruvara rwesarudzo rwechip yemusoro, izwi riri kushanda nemabhatani ezviito.

advanced.title: Inopetwa
advanced.description: Ratidza crossword iyi semutsara unovhurika nekuvhara. Kuvhura imwe kunovhara mimwe mibvunzo inopetwa iri padhuze nayo.

advanced.title: Tanga yakapetwa
advanced.description: Kana ichipetwa, tanga semutsara wakavharwa unoratidza musoro nemamiriro awo chete.

advanced.title: Fomati yemamakisi
advanced.description: OER Schema: fomati yemamakisi eongororo iyi (semuenzaniso mapoinzi, tsamba, muzana, kupedza).

advanced.title: Chinangwa chekudzidza
advanced.description: OER Schema: chinangwa chekudzidza chakabatanidzwa neongororo iyi.

developer.title: Zita rekuyedzwa
developer.description: Zita rekuyedzwa rinoshandiswa pakuzivisa xAPI muhurongwa hwekuongorora.

developer.title: Kosi
developer.description: OER Schema: kosi iyo ongororo iyi yakagadzirirwa.
